objectives: Explain the twofold nature of Jacob's blessings over the tribes.
Identify the tribes as the class teaches them, from the blessings.
takeaways: The blessings speak to each tribe in their day and in the last days, and help determine who the tribes are.
Reuben lost the excellency of the firstborn because he went up to his father's couch.
The class identifies Judah as the so-called American Black man, Judah first in the awakening (Zechariah 12:7).
The sceptre shall not depart from Judah until Shiloh come: Shiloh, the peaceful one, is Christ.
Gad, a troop shall overcome him, but he shall overcome at the last.
